card.name: Fair Hills Farm apple juice
card.description: Apple juice from Fair Hills Farm in San Miguel. Pour it cold with breakfast: the orchard belongs at the table as much as the toast does.

meet_the_maker.name: Fair Hills Farm
meet_the_maker.story: An organic orchard in San Miguel, turning a harvest into more than a pretty piece of fruit. Fair Hills presses apples into unfiltered juice and uses orchard apple juice to gently sweeten its teas. The point is the fruit: grown with care, carried through into the bottle.
